Welcome to Amsterdam Central Station. The tram stop is across from the main exit. For the city center, take tram number two. The tourist office is next to the exit, on the left. Please be careful outside: the red lanes are for bikes, so don't walk on them. Have a nice day in Amsterdam!

The car museum? Sure, it is easy. Go out of the hotel and turn right. Go straight for two blocks. At the corner, there is a big bike shop. Turn left there. The museum is next to a small park, across from a cafe. It is about ten minutes on foot. Don't take a taxi. Walking is faster here!

Camillo is in Amsterdam, and he wants to go to a car museum. He asks a woman on the street for help. She says: Go straight and turn left at the corner. The museum is next to a park, across from a cafe. Camillo says thank you and walks for ten minutes. He finds the museum, and it is amazing.
